# MEGA JS
> Daily learning OS for the JavaScript ecosystem — courses, docs, articles, and live sessions (fa/en).

MEGA JS is an education platform focused on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and the broader web stack. Primary language surfaces: Persian (fa) and English (en).

## Main hubs
- [Home (fa)](https://megajs.com/fa/): Platform overview and featured courses
- [Home (en)](https://megajs.com/en/): English marketing home
- [Learn](https://megajs.com/fa/learn): Course catalog and tracks
- [Docs](https://megajs.com/fa/docs): Technical documentation and references
- [Articles](https://megajs.com/fa/articles): Editorial guides and tutorials
- [Tunnel](https://megajs.com/fa/tunnel): Video episode series
- [Live](https://megajs.com/fa/live): Webinars and live sessions
- [Pricing](https://megajs.com/fa/pricing): Plans and access tiers
- [About](https://megajs.com/fa/about): Brand and mission
- [Contact](https://megajs.com/fa/contact): Support channels

## Optional: Key facts
- Brand: MEGA JS
- Site: https://megajs.com
- Locales: fa (default), en
- Content types: Course, Article, TechArticle / LearningResource (docs), Event (live)
